observations.why: The directive frames a mandatory gate as security and quality-of-craft: conservation (stability, preventing recurrence) and competence (mastery, ensuring artifacts are properly signed).

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: The justification appeals to security and stability — preventing past failures from recurring — which is conservation as the appealed-to good.
The gate summary carries the same conservation-plus-competence motive: a required security control ensuring quality of the deployment craft.
